title: LocalDbMigrationFailed.v1
description: Emitted by the migration runner when a single or bundle migration throws. Pairs with the corresponding `_migration_log` row; the event is the visible signal, the log is the local diagnostic.

errorMessage.description: Sanitised error message. Stack traces and file paths are stripped before emission.
